name: weighted seated leg raise on floor
description: Seated leg raise with added weight. It challenges the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your hands behind you and weight secured to your legs or between your feet.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Raise your legs up while keeping them as straight as you can.
Lower them slowly without touching the floor.
Keep your back from rounding too far.
